info.name: Procedures_GAMS_BE
info.description:
API Documentation for Procedures GAMS Backend. 

**Prerequisites**:
1. Run database seed to create Super Admin user: `superadmin@gmail.com` / `passwds12345`
2. Use the 'Local Development' environment.

request.description: Authenticates a user and returns access and refresh tokens. Automatically sets environment variables.
Refreshes the access token using a valid refresh token.
Logs out the user and revokes the refresh token.
Changes the password for the currently authenticated user.
Creates a new user. Requires SUPERADMIN role.
Retrieves all active users. Requires SUPERADMIN role.
Retrieves a specific user by ID. Requires SUPERADMIN role.
Updates a user's details. Requires SUPERADMIN role.
Soft deletes a user. Requires SUPERADMIN role.
